title: Bound no-idle query roots and paired productive stages (no new κ)
body:
Prove F≤2δ(δ+1) for rank-one square-zero query roots on independent productive fields, with no idle work and full stages on coordinate rank-two planes; δ=N−n. For the exact eighteen-call profile of pending #6833, δ≥3. Complete native/target/thin-query accounting gives raw ceilings κ<.0033288660497 for δ=3 and κ<.0029312090593 for every δ≥4. Both are below its idle-bearing .00337180 benchmark; global monotonicity excludes later re-entry.

Also prove that at rank defect Σr_i−n=2, at most five rank-two full blocks can have commuting rank-four supporting projectors. Six would require twelve dimensions but their supports span at most ten. This excludes nine synchronized native pairs even with arbitrary intervening queries and channel mixing; no prefix-commutation hypothesis is needed.

The shortest-root rank-two support cap is already known from #6398. New relative to #6832/#6842: all-defect scalar incidence bounds, complete fixed-source envelopes, and a paired-stage obstruction. Credit #6840's earlier star argument and #6839's retained native monotonicity estimate. Arbitrary thin supports, zero hub coefficients and repeated full supports are included.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6833 source: 51f54e3c31f2f3a3e056a483b3ed66ae916ad06a.
Native pricing blob: 7d9ff06de9dfbba31c06a141e6cacd9806852a41.
Exact Git/SHA256 pins: SOURCES.json and retained/SOURCE-PINS.json.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/noidle-root-defect
```
Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: eight registered normal/-O checks; separate proof reconstructions and positive/alternating-exponential rational enclosures. Deterministic controls cover 33,867 graphs, 3,905 star blocks, ten roots and 671 set extensions. Source corruption, omitted query charges, false matching, noncommuting stages and characteristic-two boundary examples are checked. Universal statements follow from proofs, not finite searches. Commit-byte/mode checks and all eight fresh Git-free export replays pass; the remote full tree matches the tested tree.

No new κ. Characteristic differs from two. The scalar result fixes the native profile and common coordinate whole-target contract; the paired result requires square-zero blocks, defect two and commuting rank-four stages. Five is not claimed attainable. Idle-bearing callers, higher defect or paid stages, noncommuting outputs and changed aggregation/interfaces remain open; a legal productive quotient and complete favorable recurrence remain unproved. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Pro assistance and separate mathematical/implementation review. Credit DreamingOfClouds (#6832/#6833) and the cited predecessors/native lineage. Apache-2.0.
